verdict_reason: Seed data migrates correctly to commodityCode and speciesLatinName, but the file has comments that describe other modules, history narration, a leftover 'cow' name and seven copies of the same set-up.

todos.issue: Comments describe other modules or carry test rationale instead of the lines below them: lines 55-56 (why the regex is anchored), 95-97 and 405-407 (what the copy parity test checks), 288-289 (what the identification obligation asks on one species), 515-516 (why overland transport is chosen).
todos.fix: Must: no comment in the file describes another module, the service's rules or the test's own rationale; names carry the intent. One way: delete the comments and let names say it, e.g. A_JOURNEY_PAGE_URL_UNDER_SET_BASE, a seed named twoIdentifiedSpeciesSeed and roadSeedShowingEveryRow, and move the copy-parity rationale to the set's docs/testing.md if it is worth keeping.

todos.issue: Comment on temporaryAdmissionSeed (lines 66-68) narrates history ('the state the retired "Exit details" task used to appear in') and makes a count claim ('the one reason that opens both').
todos.fix: Must: the seed states only what it is now, with no history and no count. One way: delete the comment and rename the seed for the state it sets up, e.g. owingExitQuestionsSeed.

todos.issue: cowLine (line 279) keeps the retired 'Cow' commodity-name vocabulary after this PR moved lines to commodityCode '0102' (cattle, CATTLE_CODE in services/commodities/rules.js); the rename stopped part-way through the concept's vocabulary.
todos.fix: Must: the local is named for what it now holds, in the vocabulary rules.js uses for 0102. One way: rename cowLine to cattleLine.

todos.issue: The same beforeAll (configureRecords, configureSession, buildDispatch) and beforeEach(store.clear) block is copied into six describe blocks (lines 129, 154, 374, 416, 455, 507, 534), and the GET /hub test re-finds the GET handler and rebuilds what renderHub already does.
todos.fix: Must: the set-up is written once and every hub test uses it. One way: wrap the handler describes in one outer describe holding a single beforeAll/beforeEach, and have the GET /hub test call renderHub().
